requirements.title: Configurable Anomaly Detection
requirements.description: System must implement threshold-based anomaly detection with user-configurable warning and critical thresholds for all metric types

validation.notes: Verify alerts triggered when thresholds exceeded

requirements.title: Platform-neutral memory-pressure reading
requirements.description: System Monitor MUST publish a memory-pressure level (normal, elevated, critical, unknown) derived from Linux PSI and swap-in rate, the macOS native pressure level, or the Windows low-memory notification, and MUST report every raw signal with an explicit state; an unsupported signal MUST NOT be reported as zero.

validation.notes: Recorded Linux /proc fixtures, macOS host_statistics64 values, and Windows PDH samples; level derivation per platform.
macOS struct layouts match the C headers.

requirements.title: Paging contributor attribution
requirements.description: When memory pressure is elevated or critical, System Monitor MUST attach the processes with the highest measured fault rate, then swapped memory, with their attributed owner; a process whose counter cannot be read MUST be reported unsupported.

validation.notes: Ranking, macOS ri_pageins and Windows PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS mapping.
Contributors only at elevated or critical pressure, with owner attribution.

requirements.title: Server-owned sustained alert lifecycle
requirements.description: The API MUST be the only alert source: a condition MUST hold for the configured sustain duration before one alert per rule and key opens, MUST stay clear for the same duration before the alert resolves, and a sustained critical alert MUST be escalated once into the anomaly and investigation pipeline. Unsupported or failed rules MUST NOT open or resolve alerts.

validation.notes: Sustain, dedup, severity escalation, auto-resolve, restart adoption, unsupported rules, ported host rules, escalation.
Level plus leak-shaped growth TCP rule, ported from the dashboard.
Orphaned-agents rule against a captured vrooli agent list --json.

requirements.title: Clients read server alerts
requirements.description: The CLI status, alerts, and watch commands and the dashboard alert panel MUST read alerts from AlertsService and MUST NOT derive alerts from metric values; a paused monitor MUST be reported as inactive, never as maintenance.

validation.notes: Status and alerts commands read the server feed.
OverallStatus regression: active monitoring is not MAINTENANCE.
Server response mapping and feed states.
Unavailable or paused feeds are never shown as no alerts.
